user.title: Add a RUNE device
user.description: Choose a name and category for the device you want to control.

add_device_name.title: Name the device
add_device_name.description: Pick a display name and a category for the new RUNE device.

add_device_transmitter.title: Pick a transmitter
add_device_transmitter.description: Select the IR or RF emitter entity that RUNE should use to send commands.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Fire a learned IR / RF pulse on a RUNE device.

command_key.name: Command
command_key.description: Key of the PulseCommand to send (e.g. power_on, speed_2, off).

learn_command.name: Learn command
learn_command.description: Start a learn session on a RUNE device — capture an IR / RF signal.

command_key.name: Command
command_key.description: Key under which to store the captured pulse.

timeout_s.name: Timeout (s)
timeout_s.description: How long to wait for the remote signal before giving up.

empty_message.message: No devices yet. Use **Add device** to create one.
